title: worldgen-core field registry
description: Raster fields exchanged between pipeline stages (plan section 4.1). Source of include/wg/generated/field_ids.hpp; regenerate with tools/codegen/gen_field_ids.py.

id.description: Numeric id; equals the array position. Ids are append-only.

name.description: Stable field name; at most 32 bytes because world files store it in a 32-byte slot.

unit.description: Short unit symbol of the stored value; empty for dimensionless or label fields.

scale.description: Meaning of the stored value (the 'Scale and units' column).

si_mapping.description: Mapping from the stored value to SI units; empty if none.

enum.description: Labels of an enumerated field, in value order starting at 0.

min_exclusive.description: True if the value must be strictly greater than min.

values.description: The only values the field may take.

note.description: Bound that depends on the grid or parameters, e.g. '>= dx^2'.
